data.body:
[P2] Do not publish files for discarded virtual results

`ChildContextOperation` serializes results before checking `isVirtual` or whether its parent already completed. Thus FLAT map/parallel branches and late-finishing branches create unique payload files whose envelopes are discarded; FLAT parallel replay repeats this on every invocation. Since the SDK never removes these files, such workflows leak storage indefinitely. Add a non-publishing normalization path or defer publication until the runtime knows the serialization will be checkpointed.
